_doc: Nevada Nights — the Exotics Racing LVMS circuit (2015-2021, target A; Kevin 2026-10-28: 'Call it Nevada Nights') through the Lake Murray chain (tools/ship_track.sh; Kevin 2026-10-28: 'rebuild all four with the Lake Murray chain'). The draft is the engine's own off the georeferenced NAIP trace (source.type aerial: aerial -> elev -> project -> mesh), then the underlay drops data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_* collections (scripts/blender/underlay.py). Authoring happens in that blend (AUTH_*), the prep / exporter / spawn builder run from airoso's scripts/ac, the four gates run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso.
